scope: C09/C10 shared lifecycle coordinator and host-event assembly
invariants: close outlets before invalidating the active generation
stop the active track and hide the overlay
share concurrent stop results without repeating cleanup
do not auto-restore capture after process restart
map Android host pause/destroy and Windows quit/renderer/window events to fixed signals
unbind lifecycle listeners without retaining a cleanup callback
require explicit native-host confirmation that capture and media are stopped
limitations: No Android lock-screen, permission-revocation, process-kill, projection or overlay device run was performed.
No Windows lock, real window movement, recursive desktop capture, display change or pass-through device run was performed.
The coordinator uses injected resource ports and synthetic signals; it does not call OS capture, notification, overlay or input APIs.
Android page notifications can be lost during process kill or WebView destruction; Windows main-process cleanup is only a preflight controller and has no production capture resources.
